metadata.title: Prodigia for schools
metadata.description: Bring Prodigia's adaptive practice to your whole classroom, with real progress tracking for every student.

hero.titulo: Adaptive practice for your whole classroom
hero.subtitulo: Mental math, logic, geography, chemistry, anatomy, music theory, trigonometry and history — with difficulty that adjusts to each student, plus duels that keep them coming back.

mundos.descripcion: Every world calibrates its own level per student — nobody gets bored going too slow, or frustrated going too fast.

adaptativo.descripcion: Each student's level goes up and down on its own, based on how they're doing — not one fixed difficulty for the whole class.

gamificado.descripcion: Streaks, achievements, Chispas and cosmetics — the same mechanics that get a student to open the app without being told to.

duelos.descripcion: Friendly competition between classmates, with ranking and rank — practice turns into a game, not homework.

seguimiento.descripcion: Accuracy, playtime and activity by topic — not just whether they logged in, but how they're actually doing.

estadisticas.descripcion: Every Pro account already has its own stats panel: accuracy by city, playtime and daily activity, with simple, easy-to-read charts.
estadisticas.piloto: We're opening a pilot for schools that want a full-classroom view, combining all their students into one panel for the teacher. Tell us about your school and we'll let you know as soon as it's ready.

precio.descripcion: Pricing depends on your school's size and whether your students already have their own accounts. Write to us and we'll send you a quote.

metadata.title: Privacy — Prodigia
metadata.description: What data Prodigia stores and what it's used for.

privacidad.intro: We're a small education app — this explains in plain language what we store and why.
privacidad.datosEmail: Your email (if you created an account with email and password).
privacidad.datosPerfil: Your display name, your profile photo (avatar) if you uploaded one, and your progress: level by world and by topic, streak, Chispas, Experience, achievements, and titles.
privacidad.datosActividad: Your practice activity: what you answered, whether you got it right, how long it took — this is what we use to calibrate difficulty to your level.
privacidad.datosDuelos: Your real-time duel history: who you played against, the result, and how your ELO moved.
privacidad.datosClan: If you're part of a clan: which one, your role there, and the messages you send in the clan chat (visible only to the rest of your clan).
privacidad.datosAmistades: Your friendships within the app (who you added, who added you).
privacidad.datosGrupo: If you're part of a teacher's group, that teacher can see your group's aggregate progress (level, streak, accuracy), never your individual answers beyond that.
privacidad.usoTexto: Only to make the app work: calibrating your level, calculating your progress, showing the ranking, the feed, and your clan's chat, and nothing else. We don't sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising purposes. Clan chat has an automatic filter for offensive language (a message that contains it is rejected before it's saved), and any message can be reported for manual review — there's no automatic content moderation beyond that filter.
privacidad.borrarTexto: From <link>your profile</link> you can delete your account completely — your progress, achievements, title, duel history, clan membership, chat messages, friendships, and everything else tied to your account gets erased permanently. One exception to keep in mind: if you played a duel against someone else and that person later deletes their account, the record of that duel may also disappear from your own history — that's not something you can prevent, it's a side effect of how the other account's data gets deleted.

metadata.title: Terms of use — Prodigia
metadata.description: Prodigia's terms of use, in plain language.

terminos.intro: This is written in plain language on purpose — it's not a complex legal contract, it's an honest explanation of what Prodigia is and how it works.
terminos.queEsTexto: Prodigia is an adaptive practice education app: mental math, logic, geography, chemistry, anatomy, music theory, and other topics that keep getting added, with difficulty that adjusts to how you're doing. It also includes real-time duels against other players (with ELO and rank), clans, friends, achievements, and a social feed. It doesn't replace a class or a formal assessment — it's a practice tool.
terminos.cuentaTexto: You can create an account with email and password, or sign in as a guest and decide later if you want to save it. You're responsible for keeping your password secure.
terminos.usoTexto: Use Prodigia to practice in good faith. Don't try to manipulate the Chispas system, the ranking, or duels with bots, scripts, or automated responses. In your clan chat and anywhere else you can write free text, don't use offensive, discriminatory, or abusive language — messages that contain it are automatically rejected before being saved, and any message or profile can be reported for manual review.
terminos.borrarTexto: You can delete your account anytime from <link>your profile</link>. That action is permanent: it deletes your progress, achievements, duel history, clan membership, chat messages, and everything else tied to your account, and it can't be undone. If you played a duel against someone who later deletes their account, that duel may also disappear from your own history — it's a side effect of how deletion works, not something you can prevent on the other end.
